nodes.label: Offline Flow-Level PERMIT/BLOCK RL Formulation
nodes.rationale: Positioned between RL-as-classifier and RL-as-mitigator-in-SDN; the gap is methodological/experimental rather than first-ever algorithmic, addressing reproducible evaluation of binary defender decisions with cost-sensitive reward under the same pipeline compared to supervised baselines.

nodes.label: QRDQN Agent for PERMIT/BLOCK
nodes.rationale: Chosen as a reasonable value-based algorithm; originality lies in experimental design, comparison with supervised baselines, data efficiency, and train/test separation, not in QRDQN novelty per se.

nodes.label: Data-Efficiency Curve Protocol
nodes.rationale: Evaluates how performance changes as training data increases across controlled budget sizes (smoke/medium/full), with fixed split and multiple seeds to ensure comparable baselines.

nodes.label: Random Forest Supervised Baseline Protocol
nodes.rationale: Primary tabular baseline on the same canonical schema and splits; must run before any claim that QRDQN outperforms supervised learning.

nodes.label: Leakage Controls Policy
nodes.rationale: Drop IP addresses, absolute timestamps, flow IDs, and unique identifiers; avoid ports as direct label proxies; run shuffled-label anti-leakage check. Reduces but does not fully eliminate leakage.

nodes.label: External Validation Plan A/B/C
nodes.rationale: Plan A: full lab validation; Plan B: benign-only false-positive sanity check; Plan C: no usable lab artifact, CICIDS2017 strict-split as main evidence. Validation must be presented as distribution-shift exploration, not deployment proof.

nodes.label: Classification-as-RL Formulation
nodes.rationale: Frames flow classification as a contextual bandit MDP where state=flow vector, action=PERMIT/BLOCK, reward=cost-sensitive scalar. Mathematically closer to cost-sensitive classification than a full sequential MDP; used to reuse RL libraries (Gymnasium, SB3-contrib) and prepare for future sequential extensions.

nodes.label: Dataset-as-Environment Pattern
nodes.rationale: Static labeled dataset exposed via Gymnasium API; transitions are independent re-samples, making this a contextual bandit not a full MDP. Justified for controlled RL-vs-supervised comparison; explicitly declared as non-sequential.

nodes.label: Quantile Huber Loss for Return Distribution
nodes.rationale: QRDQN outputs N quantile values per action; action selection uses their mean. Enables risk-aware policies by focusing on low-quantile returns (CVaR) for catastrophic-outcome avoidance, aligned with FN-heavy reward asymmetry.
nodes.norm_label: quantile huber loss for return distribution

nodes.label: Cost-Sensitive Asymmetric Reward Design
nodes.rationale: Reward r=+1 correct, r=-C_FN for FN (attack permitted), r=-C_FP for FP (benign blocked), with C_FN > C_FP. Reflects that missed attacks cause higher damage than unnecessary blocking. Weights derived from literature assumptions, not tuned on test set.

nodes.label: FN/FP Asymmetry in IDS
nodes.rationale: FN (missed attack) leads to compromise, data loss, service disruption. FP (benign blocked) causes operational overhead and availability loss. This asymmetry motivates cost-sensitive IDS modeling and must be reflected in reward design without claiming weights are universally optimal.

nodes.label: Autonomous Cyber Defense (ACD) with DRL
nodes.rationale: ACD systems use DRL in simulated attack graphs (CyberBattleSim, CAGE). More abstract than flow-level NIDS; provides conceptual support for defender-as-sequential-decision-maker framing. Not implemented scope in this TFG.

nodes.label: Safe Thesis Positioning (Experimental/Methodological Contribution)
nodes.rationale: Thesis contribution is a reproducible, scoped experimental prototype: binary flow-level PERMIT/BLOCK with QRDQN over 76-feature canonical schema, with supervised baseline comparison, data-efficiency analysis, leakage-aware evaluation, and planned/preferred external lab validation. Not production-ready, not first-ever, not deployment-proven.

nodes.label: Gymnasium Environment: 152-Dim Observation (76 features + 76 mask)
nodes.rationale: Each row from CICIDS2017 mapped through canonical schema to 76 flow features plus 76 missingness-mask values forming a 152-dimensional observation vector for QRDQN agent.

nodes.label: B-Profile System for Benign Traffic Generation
nodes.rationale: Models behavior of 25 users over HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SSH, email to approximate realistic enterprise usage; limited service diversity means benign class may not represent modern apps (video, P2P, cloud APIs).
nodes.norm_label: b-profile system for benign traffic generation

nodes.label: 76 Canonical Features + 76 Missingness Mask (152 obs)
nodes.rationale: Described in canonical_schema.py; binary labels: 0=BENIGN, 1=ATTACK; actions: 0=PERMIT, 1=BLOCK. Provides stable input schema across CICIDS2017 and external lab traffic phases.

nodes.label: Risk-Aware Policy via Return Distribution Quantiles
nodes.rationale: Low-quantile returns can inform risk-averse PERMIT decisions; distributional estimate could be exploited for CVaR-based policies. In the thesis, mean of quantiles is used for action selection; distribution preserved for future risk-sensitive work.
nodes.norm_label: risk-aware policy via return distribution quantiles
